profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google | Android Auto

positions.title: Android Developer
positions.description: Member of the Android team of the UCLA Library. Worked on creating and maintaining the official library mobile app.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Used machine learning to create upsell model creation, training, and deployment pipeline, which entailed:
• Feature brainstorm and analysis
• Aggregating user data into model training data sets using Pandas and mySQL queries
• Training and testing Apache Spark predicting models using techniques such as One-Hot-Encoding and Feature Hashing
• Utilizing the SciPy optimizer tool to calculate offer pricepoints based off of user information
• Setting up local server API which returns precomputed offer pricepoints

positions.title: Android Mobile SDK and Client Applications Intern
positions.description:
• Developed and published the Flextrip app to the Google Play Store
• Started development of Nor1 Android SDK and wrote associated API and informational documents
• Analyzed and recorded the designs and layouts behind the success of numerous popular android apps on the Google Play Store

positions.title: Animal Discovery Room Intern
positions.description:
• Gave informative speeches and handled a variety of animals during public exhibitions
• Educated visitors on interesting facts about the creatures
• Assisted in the cleaning and feeding of dozens of animals
• Maintained records of food stocks 
• Listened to and resolved visitors’ questions and complaints

positions.title: Exhibit Floor Volunteer
positions.description:
• Explained and supervised a number of interactive and educational exhibits
• Educated visitors on various mathematical and physical properties that the exhibits demonstrate
• Directed visitors on how to navigate the building

projects.title: in kitchen
projects.description: Created a web app that took user inputs of cooking ingredients and ran them through a server of recipes before returning and displaying the ones that included the inputted list of food. Created with Javascript, HTML, and CSS.

projects.title: MicroMouse
projects.description: Using an Auduino and several infrared sensors, created an autonomous maze-solving robot that could find its way to the center of a 16 X 16 maze. Constructing the mouse included designing an efficient maze-solving algorithm, designing and purchasing the parts, planning and soldering the circuits, and mounting and calibrating the sensors.
